name: ovos-flashrank-reranker-plugin
description: This plugin adds FlashRank-based reranking to the Open Voice OS (OVOS) platform. It picks the best answer to a question from a list of candidate answers. It can also extract the most relevant sentence from a text passage. It uses the FlashRank library to score and rank candidates by relevance to the query.
author: TigreGotico

setup_notes.heading: Configuration
setup_notes.content:
The `common_query` framework in OVOS uses a `MultipleChoiceSolver` to pick the best answer from several skill responses. Set this plugin as the reranker:

"common_query": {
  "reranker": "ovos-flashrank-reranker-plugin",
  "ignore_skill_scores": true,
  "ovos-flashrank-reranker-plugin": {"model": "ms-marco-TinyBERT-L-2-v2"}
}

> NOTE: On a Raspberry Pi, this adds up to 1 second of extra latency to the common query pipeline.

### Available models

The default model is `ms-marco-MultiBERT-L-12`, because it supports many languages.
